audit.why: Renekton front-loads levels 2-6 and decays; Karma's poke and first-item spike claim the back half. That averages to an even lane, not a 7/10.
audit.corrected: diffRating 5.5/10, carryRating 6.5/10, difficulty lines reworded to even.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven rows disagreed with their own whys — Level 1 was Karma while its why says 'neither of you owns this stage outright', Level 3 was Renekton while its why calls it 'a coinflip on cooldowns', Levels 4-5 was Renekton while its why says 'your bullying peak', Level 6 was Karma while its why says 'the level-6 spike is his', and both item rows were Renekton while their whys give them to Karma.
audit.why: Renekton owns level 2 (first full Fury bar) and level 6 (Dominus); Karma owns 4-5 and both item stages. The packet levelChart states exactly this.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to Skill / Renekton / Skill / Karma / Renekton / Karma / Karma in matched pairs across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells the player to hold the Inspire shield for the empowered Ruthless Predator so 'his full-fury combo finds half-damage'. Above 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on the target outright and stuns for 1.5 seconds instead of 0.75. The shield does not absorb it — it is deleted by it.
audit.why: This is the single most damaging error on the page: it instructs the player to spend their only defensive layer into the one ability that removes it. The correct play is to spend Inspire's move speed to leave after the stun, or before he reaches 50 Fury. Ruthless Predator is also an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1], dosFull[0].t, dosFull[0].d and the early text now state the shield destruction and the 1.5s empowered stun; dontsFull[0].d states the auto-reset tell.
sources: kit: Ruthless Predator — 'destroying damage shields on the target', 1.5s stun, autoReset flag

edits.before: Level 1 is yours to start: Mantra is up immediately, so open with an RQ Soulflare zone from outside his range before he has the fury to punish you back. The danger arrives at 2-3: once his rage bar is full, his empowered W (Ruthless Predator) is a hard point-click stun, and his E Slice in into that stun into Q is a near-lethal combo you cannot out-trade flat. Trade your Q for chip when his fury is empty, and hold your Inspire shield for the moment he Slices forward with a full bar; that shield is the only thing that turns his all-in from a kill into a survivable trade.
edits.after: Level 1 is contested: Mantra is up immediately, so open with an RQ Soulflare zone from outside his range, but he is a point-click stat-checker who trades back. The danger arrives at 2-3: past 50 Fury his empowered W (Ruthless Predator) stuns for 1.5 seconds AND destroys damage shields, so Inspire cannot absorb it — E Slice in, W stun, Q is near-lethal. Trade your Q for chip while his fury is empty, and spend Inspire's move speed to leave after the stun rather than to eat it; the shield only counts once his bar is spent.
